name: Cu Mong crab
summary: Crab from Đầm Cù Mông with sweet, fragrant meat. Steamed until the shell turns red and the meat white, it is dipped in salt, pepper, and lime.
origin: Phu Yen. Đầm Cù Mông, on Du lịch Phú Yên’s 29 December 2020 note.
taste: Sweet and fragrant, with salt, pepper, and lime as the dip.
howToEat: Steam it and dip the white meat in salt, pepper, and lime. Ghẹ rang muối, ghẹ rim me, and súp ghẹ are the other plates.
seoTitle: Cu Mong crab — steamed, with salt, pepper, and lime
seoDescription: Sweet crab from dam Cu Mong, steamed red and dipped in salt, pepper, and lime.
